policy.description: Call routing policy used to dispatch calls to agents.

waitingEnabled.description: If `false`, then the option is treated as "Advance when busy". The hunt group won't ring agents when they're on a call and advances to the next agent. If a hunt group agent has call waiting enabled and the call is advanced to them, the call waits until that hunt group agent isn't busy.

groupBusyEnabled.description: If `true`, the hunt group busy status will be set to busy. All new calls will get busy treatment. If `busyRedirect` is enabled, the calls are routed to the destination specified in `busyRedirect`.

allowMembersToControlGroupBusyEnabled.description: If true, agents can change the hunt group busy status.

nextAgentEnabled.description: If enabled, advance to next agent after the `nextAgentRings` has occurred.

nextAgentRings.description: Number of rings before call will be forwarded if unanswered and `nextAgentEnabled` is true.

forwardEnabled.description: If `true`, forwards unanswered calls to the destination after the number of rings occurs.

numberOfRings.description: Number of rings before forwarding calls if `forwardEnabled` is true.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: If `forwardEnabled` is true, enables and disables sending incoming to destination number's voicemail if the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled. If `destinationVoicemailEnabled` is enabled, then *55 is added as a prefix for `destination`.

noAnswer.description: Settings for when the call into the hunt group is not answered.

enabled.description: If `true`, calls are diverted to a defined phone number when all agents are busy, or when the hunt group busy status is set to busy.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: The enabled or disabled state of sending diverted incoming calls to the `destination` number's voicemail if the `destination` is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled. If `destinationVoicemailEnabled` is enabled, then *55 is added as a prefix for `destination`.

busyRedirect.description: Settings for sending calls to a specified destination when all agents are busy or when the hunt group busy status is set to busy.

enabled.description: If `true`, unreachable, unanswered calls are diverted to a defined phone number. For persons with only a mobile device, calls won't be diverted if there is a network outage.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: The enabled or disabled state of sending diverted incoming calls to the `destination` number's voicemail if the `destination` is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled. If `destinationVoicemailEnabled` is enabled, then *55 is added as a prefix for `destination`.

businessContinuityRedirect.description: Settings for sending calls to a specified destination if the phone is not connected to the network for any reason, such as a power outage, failed internet connection, or wiring problem.
